description.en: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
description.zh_cn: 通过释放臭臭的气味，在攻击的时候，有时会使对手畏缩。

description.en: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会将天气变为下雨。

description.en: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.
description.zh_cn: 每一回合速度会变快。

description.en: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
description.zh_cn: 被坚硬的甲壳守护着，不会被对手的攻击击中要害。

description.en: It cannot be knocked out with one hit. One-hit KO moves cannot knock it out, either.
description.zh_cn: 即使受到对手的招式攻击，也不会被一击打倒。一击必杀的招式也没有效果。

description.en: Prevents the use of explosive moves such as Self-Destruct by dampening its surroundings.
description.zh_cn: 通过把周围都弄湿，使谁都无法使用自爆等爆炸类的招式。

description.en: Its limber body protects the Pokémon from paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 因为身体柔软，不会变为麻痹状态。

description.en: Boosts the Pokémon's evasion in a sandstorm.
description.zh_cn: 在沙暴的时候，闪避率会提高。

description.en: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity, so contact with it may cause paralysis.
description.zh_cn: 身上带有静电，有时会让接触到的对手麻痹。

description.en: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.
description.zh_cn: 受到电属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

description.en: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move, instead of taking damage.
description.zh_cn: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

description.en: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.
description.zh_cn: 因为感觉迟钝，不会变为着迷和被挑衅状态。

description.en: Eliminates the effects of weather.
description.zh_cn: 任何天气的影响都会消失。

description.en: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.
description.zh_cn: 因为拥有复眼，招式的命中率会提高。

description.en: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.
description.zh_cn: 因为是不会睡觉的体质，所以不会变为睡眠状态。

description.en: The Pokémon's type becomes the type of the move used on it.
description.zh_cn: 自己的属性会变为从对手处所受招式的属性。

description.en: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.
description.zh_cn: 因为体内拥有免疫能力，不会变为中毒状态。

description.en: Powers up the Pokémon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.
description.zh_cn: 受到火属性的招式攻击时，吸收火焰，自己使出的火属性招式会变强。

description.en: This Pokémon's dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.
description.zh_cn: 被鳞粉守护着，不会受到招式的追加效果影响。

description.en: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.
description.zh_cn: 因为我行我素，不会变为混乱状态。

description.en: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.
description.zh_cn: 用吸盘牢牢贴在地面上，让替换宝可梦的招式和道具无效。

description.en: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.
description.zh_cn: 出场时威吓对手，让其退缩，降低对手的攻击。

description.en: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadow to prevent it from escaping.
description.zh_cn: 踩住对手的影子使其无法逃走或替换。

description.en: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.
description.zh_cn: 受到攻击时，用粗糙的皮肤弄伤接触到自己的对手。

description.en: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 不可思议的力量，只有效果绝佳的招式才能击中。

description.en: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 从地面浮起，从而不会受到地面属性招式的攻击。

description.en: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.

description.zh_cn: 将自己的中毒、麻痹或灼伤状态传染给对手。

description.en: Makes status moves more likely to miss.
description.zh_cn: 成为不易受到变化招式攻击的身体。

description.en: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.
description.zh_cn: 如果在最后使出招式，招式的威力会提高。

description.en: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in the party's last spot.
description.zh_cn: 假扮成同行队伍中的最后一个宝可梦出场，迷惑对手。

description.en: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.
description.zh_cn: 变身为当前面对的宝可梦。

description.en: Passes through the opposing Pokémon's barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.
description.zh_cn: 可以穿透对手的壁障或替身进行攻击。

description.en: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.
description.zh_cn: 被对手接触到后，会将对手变为木乃伊。

description.en: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 如果打倒对手，就会充满自信，攻击会提高。

description.en: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.
description.zh_cn: 受到恶属性的招式攻击时，因为正义感，攻击会提高。

description.en: Dark-, Ghost-, and Bug-type moves scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 受到恶属性、幽灵属性和虫属性的招式攻击时，会因胆怯而速度提高。

description.en: Reflects status moves, instead of getting hit by them.
description.zh_cn: 可以不受到由对手使出的变化招式影响，并将其反弹。

description.en: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move, instead of taking damage.
description.zh_cn: 受到草属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是攻击会提高。

description.en: Gives priority to a status move.
description.zh_cn: 可以率先使出变化招式。

description.en: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
description.zh_cn: 沙暴天气时，岩石属性、地面属性和钢属性的招式威力会提高。

description.en: Inflicts damage to the attacker on contact with iron barbs.
description.zh_cn: 用铁刺给予接触到自己的对手伤害。

description.en: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is half or less.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ变为一半以下时，样子会改变。

description.en: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
description.zh_cn: 自己和同伴的命中率会提高。

description.en: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
description.zh_cn: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

description.en: Moves can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
description.zh_cn: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

description.en: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.
description.zh_cn: 可以防住向自己和同伴发出的心灵攻击。

description.en: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.
description.zh_cn: 我方的草属性宝可梦能力不会降低，也不会变为异常状态。

description.en: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.
description.zh_cn: 无论是哪种树果，食用后，ＨＰ都会回复。

description.en: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.
description.zh_cn: 变为与自己使出的招式相同的属性。

description.en: Halves the damage from physical moves.
description.zh_cn: 对手给予的物理招式的伤害会减半。

description.en: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.
description.zh_cn: 夺走被自己的招式击中的对手的道具。

description.en: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.
description.zh_cn: 可以防住对手的球和弹类招式。

description.en: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.
description.zh_cn: 如果能力被降低，特攻就会大幅提高。

description.en: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
description.zh_cn: 因为颚部强壮，啃咬类招式的威力会提高。

description.en: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
description.zh_cn: 一般属性的招式会变为冰属性。威力会少量提高。

description.en: Prevents itself and ally Pokémon from falling asleep.
description.zh_cn: 我方的宝可梦不会变为睡眠状态。

description.en: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King's Shield.
description.zh_cn: 如果使出攻击招式，会变为刀剑形态，如果使出招式“王者盾牌”，会变为盾牌形态。

description.en: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the  Pokémon's HP is full.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ全满时，飞行属性的招式可以率先使出。

description.en: Powers up aura and pulse moves.
description.zh_cn: 波动和波导类招式的威力会提高。

description.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat in  Grassy Terrain.
description.zh_cn: 在青草场地时，防御会提高。

description.en: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.
description.zh_cn: 同伴使用道具时，会把自己持有的道具传递给同伴。

description.en: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
description.zh_cn: 接触到对手的招式威力会提高。

description.en: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
description.zh_cn: 一般属性的招式会变为妖精属性。威力会少量提高。

description.en: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 对于用攻击接触到自己的对手，会降低其速度。

description.en: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
description.zh_cn: 一般属性的招式会变为飞行属性。威力会少量提高。

description.en: Parent and child each attacks.
description.zh_cn: 亲子俩可以合计攻击２次。

description.en: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 全体的恶属性招式变强。

description.en: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 全体的妖精属性招式变强。

description.en: The effects of "Aura" Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
description.zh_cn: 让气场的效果发生逆转，降低威力。

description.en: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
description.zh_cn: 变为不会受到火属性攻击的天气。

description.en: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
description.zh_cn: 变为不会受到水属性攻击的天气。

description.en: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type's weaknesses.
description.zh_cn: 变为令飞行属性的弱点消失的天气。

description.en: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.
description.zh_cn: 受到攻击时，防御会提高。

description.en: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ变为一半时，会慌慌张张逃走，退回同行队伍中。

description.en: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ变为一半时，为了回避危险，会退回到同行队伍中。

description.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.
description.zh_cn: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，防御会大幅提高。

description.en: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
description.zh_cn: 攻击中毒状态的对手时，必定会击中要害。

description.en: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ变为一半时，壳会坏掉，变得有攻击性。

description.en: Doubles the damage dealt to the target's replacement if the target switches out.
description.zh_cn: 可以对替换出场的对手以２倍的伤害进行攻击。

description.en: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
description.zh_cn: 降低与自己相对的火属性招式的威力，不会灼伤。

description.en: Powers up Steel-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 钢属性的招式威力会提高。

description.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a  hit that causes its HP to become half or less.
description.zh_cn: 因对手的攻击ＨＰ变为一半时，特攻会提高。

description.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm.
description.zh_cn: 冰雹天气时，速度会提高。

description.en: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
description.zh_cn: 可以不接触对手就使出所有的招式。

description.en: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 所有的声音招式都变为水属性。

description.en: Gives priority to a healing move.
description.zh_cn: 可以率先使出回复招式。

description.en: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
description.zh_cn: 一般属性的招式会变为电属性。威力会少量提高。

description.en: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
description.zh_cn: 电气场地时，速度会变为２倍。

description.en: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ多的时候会聚起来变强。ＨＰ剩余量变少时，群体会分崩离析。

description.en: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
description.zh_cn: 通过画皮覆盖住身体，可以防住１次攻击。

description.en: Defeating an opposing Pokémon strengthens the Pokémon's bond with its Trainer, and it becomes Ash-Greninja. Water Shuriken gets more powerful.
description.zh_cn: 打倒对手时，与训练家的牵绊会增强，变为小智版甲贺忍蛙。飞水手里剑的招式威力会增强。

description.en: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ变为一半时，细胞们会赶来支援，变为完全体形态。

description.en: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
description.zh_cn: 可以使钢属性和毒属性的宝可梦也陷入中毒状态。

description.en: It's always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.
description.zh_cn: 总是半梦半醒的状态，绝对不会醒来。可以就这么睡着进行攻击。

description.en: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
description.zh_cn: 向对手施加威慑力，使其无法对我方使出先制招式。

description.en: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
description.zh_cn: 被对手打倒的时候，会给予对手相当于ＨＰ剩余量的伤害。

description.en: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.
description.zh_cn: 有谁使出跳舞招式时，自己也能就这么接着使出跳舞招式。

description.en: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
description.zh_cn: 会提高我方的特殊招式的威力。

description.en: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
description.zh_cn: 会将对手所给予的接触类招式的伤害减半，但火属性招式的伤害会变为２倍。

description.en: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
description.zh_cn: 让对手吓一跳，使其无法对我方使出先制招式。

description.en: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.
description.zh_cn: 宝可梦每次变为濒死状态时，特攻会提高。

description.en: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
description.zh_cn: 对于用攻击接触到自己的对手，会降低其速度。

description.en: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
description.zh_cn: 继承被打倒的同伴的特性，变为相同的特性。

description.en: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
description.zh_cn: 继承被打倒的同伴的特性，变为相同的特性。

description.en: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
description.zh_cn: 打倒对手的时候，自己最高的那项能力会提高。

description.en: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the memory disc it holds.
description.zh_cn: 根据持有的存储碟，自己的属性会改变。

description.en: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会布下电气场地。

description.en: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会布下精神场地。

description.en: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会布下薄雾场地。

description.en: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
description.zh_cn: 出场时，会布下青草场地。

description.en: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.
description.zh_cn: 不会因为对手的招式或特性而被降低能力。

description.en: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
description.zh_cn: ＨＰ全满时，受到的伤害会变少。

description.en: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
description.zh_cn: 受到效果绝佳的攻击时，可以减弱其威力。

description.en: Powers up moves that are super effective.
description.zh_cn: 效果绝佳的攻击，威力会变得更强。
